panel.not_measured: tools/score_ref_panel.py needs SGLang's /generate with input_ids, return_logprob and token_ids_logprob; Strata serves only /v1/chat/completions, /v1/messages and /v1/responses, none of which returns logprobs, and teacher-forced logprobs are available only from an engine started with STRATA_LOGPOS, which needs a restart of the server that this measurement was not allowed to do. No number is estimated here.

needle.note: tools/needle.py --tokens 175000 --depth 0.8 (the tool's 1.3 tokens/word guess lands at 185,756 real prompt tokens for these words); server log: 185,756 tokens read in 312.6 s (594.2 tok/s), 10 generated

greedy_text_match.what: free-running greedy completion (thinking off) of each reference-panel prompt compared with the exllamav3 reference completion: characters that match before the first difference. NOT the panel's top-1/KL metric, no band applies; prompt token counts equal the panel's prompt_len (23 checked), so the chat template is the same
greedy_text_match.reading: greedy text diverges at the first near-tie token (openings are the least predictable tokens), 0 of 8 completions are identical and 6 of 8 differ within 35 characters; this cannot show the 0.987 top-1 band is met and the target's band is unverified for this config

campaign_gate.source: campaign teacher-forced gate (engine started with STRATA_LOGPOS; 8 own prompts, 705 positions, KL on the top-64 support), run on config G on 2026-10-18; not this run and not the kit's panel

vs_config_E_and_F.note: bit-identical logprobs on all 705 positions: config G changes speed only

campaign_gate.p_off: the engine's saved baseline before the transport changes (same weights, same quantisation), not the exllamav3 reference

speed.config: Strata v0.1.41 + patches 0001-0024 (config G; recipe repo sybil-solutions/qwen38-flash-next-3090-usb-offload 81c637f), Mac mini M4 16 GB host + RTX 3090 24 GB over a USB dock; EXL3 3.05 bpw, all 512 experts; Metal cold experts, 6400-slot RAM LRU; elastic k8v4 KV 204,800; MTP draft 4; vision; one request at a time; live config md5 ff78909a, engine strata_o23b 05ec22e5; sweep.py --api openai (token counts from the server's usage)
speed.api: openai (tools/sweep.py --api openai, added in this PR)
speed.concurrency_note: the server runs one request at a time (/v1/status concurrency.serving = 1): C2-C4 requests queue behind each other (ttft_max 58 / 132 / 165 s) and the aggregate stays at the single-stream rate; there is no batching to measure
speed.early_exit: disabled (--no-early-exit): best_known.json holds an SGLang / PCIe 4.0 x16 reference that this USB-attached config is not meant to meet; no best_known entry is beaten, none updated
speed.counting: no /tokenize on Strata: prefill tok/s = server-reported usage.prompt_tokens / client time to the first content token (8,129 / 16,288 / 32,711 / 64,743 tokens, cached_tokens 0 on all 12; random-word prompts with a unique nonce); decode tokens = usage.completion_tokens; the server's own prompt_per_second is kept in speed.prefill.*.server_prompt_per_second and agrees within 1.1 %
speed.c1_32k_note: round 1 read all 32,612 prefix+prompt tokens; round 2 reused 16,384 of them from the first round's checkpoint (the server's prefix cache) and read 16,228
speed.campaign_figures_not_from_this_run: campaign ABBA on the same config, 29 realistic prompts: decode 33.38 tok/s, 12 probe prompts 28.91; prefill on real text 240 / 606 / 703 / 762 tok/s at 2.5K / 8K / 19.5K / 33.8K tokens. The protocol's random-word prompts give lower prefill (random words route to more cold experts) and the protocol's long natural answers decode at 30.8

notes: Config G of the Strata USB recipe: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next EXL3 3.05 bpw, all 512 experts per layer exact, RTX 3090 24 GB in a USB dock (USB 3.2 10 Gb/s, card link PCIe Gen3 x2) driven by a Mac mini M4 16 GB whose Metal GPU computes the cold experts from a 6,400-slot RAM LRU backed by NVMe; elastic k8v4 KV up to 204,800 tokens, vision, MTP speculative decoding with 4 drafts. New hardware class (PROMPT.md step 8): not a PCIe x16 Linux host, no container, engine Strata v0.1.41 (not SGLang + trellis-serve). launch.image is therefore the sha256 of the recipe's 25-file verification manifest at the pinned commit, not a registry image. WHAT COULD NOT BE DONE: (1) the reference-panel top-1 / KL, because Strata exposes no logprobs and the server could not be restarted with its logprob dump (quality.panel.not_measured); (2) tools/hw_bw.py, because the card is not a CUDA device on the Mac; nvme_rand ran on the Mac with F_NOCACHE; probe.py and memwatch.sh are Linux-only, so the probe was assembled from sysctl/vm_stat/diskutil and tools/memwatch_macos.sh was used; (3) concurrency: the server serves one request at a time; (4) step 7 tuning was not run (config G is the end of a campaign whose knob table is in the recipe repo; the server stays as is). Only the requests sent here appeared in the server's request counter (44 -> 81 for the sweep and needle; the panel check and a chat request came before). Registry: local-ai-registry PRs #317 (config F) and #319 (config G, stacked), all six lab gates pass, lab decode 24.7 tok/s as chars/4 lower bound, server log 30.6 tok/s.
platform: macOS (Apple M4 host) + USB-attached RTX 3090; Strata engine, not SGLang
